content:
[L] high | top-left corner | The window title "Issue Radar" is clipped at the left edge, with the first character cut off.
[C] high | right two-thirds of the screen | The entire right and lower region is a large empty dead zone while all content is crushed into a narrow left column (~500px wide).
[L] high | SLA card bottom | The last "open →" link sits at the very bottom edge of the card and is clipped by the card/window boundary.
[S] high | alerts card rows | Vertical gaps between alert rows are uneven (larger gap after row 2 than between rows 3–4), breaking rhythm.
[S] med | SLA card | The SLA card is narrower than the alerts card above it, so their left-column edges don't align on a shared grid.
[S] med | SLA card rows | The "open →" links are nearly touching the pink pills above them, with cramped, inconsistent spacing versus the alert card's row spacing.
[H] med | alerts card | Alert severity badges ("warning", "info") use pale low-contrast chips while the body text and "Open" links carry equal weight, so severity — the most important signal — doesn't stand out.
[H] med | SLA card | Metadata ("Support · breached") is embedded inline at equal weight with ticket titles, with no typographic hierarchy between primary and secondary info.
[C] med | SLA card | Four pink "breached" pills plus pink header text produce alarm-red noise with no severity differentiation — everything is breached, so nothing reads as prioritized.
[H] low | alerts card header | "6 radar alert(s)" uses a raw count with "(s)" notation, reading like debug output rather than product copy.
[C] low | top bar | The three buttons ("Detect gaps now", "Reload clusters", "Cluster now") float right with no grouping or menu container, reading as debug-tool controls.
[S] low | alerts card | Badges have inconsistent left offsets relative to card padding versus the SLA card's pill insets.
[H] low | tab bar | Inactive tabs (Clusters, Gaps, Known issues) are faded to near-illegible gray, dropping contrast below comfortable reading.
[S] med | alerts card "Open" links | "Open" action links are inconsistently spaced from message text (different x-positions per row), not aligned to a shared column.
[C] low | overall | No header hierarchy beyond the tiny clipped title; the screen reads as stacked debug panels rather than a product dashboard.

VERDICT: Unprofessional — a clipped title, massive dead space, misaligned cards, and raw debug-style output make this far below commercial helpdesk standards.
